CausationId.description: Reference to the command or event that caused another fact.

ContextQualifiedId.description:
A canonical `<context>_<opaque>` reference.

Context names are lowercase ASCII slugs. Opaque components are deliberately
restricted to lowercase base36-compatible text so comparison is stable
across databases, filesystems, and URL encoders.

CorrelationId.description: Trace-safe correlation reference spanning one logical request.

organization_id.description: Explicit local tenant scope; retries must address the same organization.

owner_actor_id.description: Pre-authenticated human owner reference; no password is created.
